QuestInfo.name: Excavated: Snapshots
QuestInfo.0: You found one of Spiegelmann's lost tools while you were looking for artifacts.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann was very happy to see his precious camera with its precious photos of artifacts and his personal duck-face shots!
QuestInfo.1: Bring this back to Spiegelmann. He'll probably be excited!

0.0: Hey! That's my camera! What are you doing with my camera?!

no.0: Don't you sass me! Let me have a look. If it has a little notch on the left hand shutter controls...

1.0: This IS my camera! Where in the world did you find it?! I've been taking terrible cell phone pictures of myself for WEEKS now! With this, I can finally get back to properly documenting the excavations.
1.1: You did a good thing, bringing this back to me, #b#h0##k. If you see any other tools I lost, bring them back! I'll make it worth your while.
